fullPassage: There is no known cure for the ills of ownership. As Adam Smith said, ownership is woven into our lives. But being aware of it might help. Everywhere around us we see the temptation to improve the quality of our lives by buying a larger home, a second car, a new dishwasher, a lawn mower, and so on. But, once we upgrade our possessions we have a very hard time going back down. Ownership simply changes our perspective. Suddenly, moving backward to our pre-ownership state is a loss, one that we cannot accept. And so, while moving up in life, we fall into the fantasy that we can always return to the previous state, but in reality, it's unlikely. Downgrading to a smaller home, for instance, is experienced as a loss, it is psychologically painful, and we are willing to make all kinds of sacrifices in order to avoid such losses.

det.korean: 'woven into our lives'는 직조처럼 '깊이 짜여 들어가 있어 분리할 수 없다'는 비유. 소유가 인간 삶의 일부로 단단히 박혀 떼어내기 어렵다는 의미.
det.analysis:
❌ ① 시대 변화: woven은 '엮여 있음'을 뜻하며 시대성과 무관
❌ ② 정기 교체: woven은 분리 어려움 — 교체와 정반대
✅ ③ 깊이 짜여 분리하기 어려움 — woven into의 비유적 의미
❌ ④ 부유층 한정: 본문 our lives는 일반화된 우리 — 한정 아님
det.tip: be woven into ~ = ~에 깊이 짜여(스며들어) 있다. 분리 불가능성 강조.

questions.passage: There is no known cure for the ills of ownership. As Adam Smith said, ownership is woven into our lives. But <u>being aware of it</u> might help. Everywhere around us we see the temptation to improve the quality of our lives by buying a larger home, a second car, a new dishwasher, a lawn mower, and so on. But, once we upgrade our possessions we have a very hard time going back down. Ownership simply changes our perspective. Suddenly, moving backward to our pre-ownership state is a loss, one that we cannot accept. And so, while moving up in life, we fall into the fantasy that we can always return to the previous state, but in reality, it's unlikely. Downgrading to a smaller home, for instance, is experienced as a loss, it is psychologically painful, and we are willing to make all kinds of sacrifices in order to avoid such losses.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 <u>it</u>이 가리키는 것으로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 'But being aware of it might help' — it은 앞 문장들에서 다룬 '소유(ownership)' 또는 그 폐해를 지시. 알아차리면 도움이 된다는 맥락.
det.analysis:
✅ ① 소유 (또는 폐해): S1~S2의 ownership/ills of ownership을 지시
❌ ② 더 큰 집: S4 이후 등장 — it 시점에 등장 안 함
❌ ③ Adam Smith 책: 본문에 없음
❌ ④ 치료법: S1은 '치료법 없음' — 알아차림 대상 아님
det.tip: being aware of ___ = 인식 대상. 앞 두 문장의 핵심 명사 ownership.

det.korean: 'moving backward to our pre-ownership state is a loss, one that we cannot accept' — one은 바로 앞에 등장한 'a loss'를 가리키는 부정대명사. '받아들일 수 없는 손실'.
